issues.display_title: Issue #1609: Enhancement: Agency domain ADR foundation (shared infra)
issues.main_description_html:
Part 1/3 of the Agency Domain Passthrough enhancement — shared ADR foundation for the Agency domain. No route or response behavior changes.

Enhancement architecture

Target: Domain-Based ADR per docs/ARCH_RULES.md.

Controller (single public handle: HTTP input + envelope + exception mapping)
   -> Action (one use case, no HTTP)
      -> Service (optional domain logic)
         -> Repository (the ONLY place with SQL)
  • Contracts: app/DTOs/Agency/*Dto
  • Failures: app/Exceptions/Agency/*Exception, mapped to HTTP status at the controller edge by AgencyExceptionHttpMapper
  • Envelope: App\Helpers\Api\ResponseEnvelopeHelper
  • Encryption is a transport concern: it stays in the controller, never in Action/Service/Repository
  • Reference implementation: app/Http/Controllers/Photographers/Portfolio/GetPortfolioController.php

Scope

Create:

  • app/Exceptions/Agency/AgencyDomainException.php (base, exposes getDomainCode())
  • app/Exceptions/Agency/AgencyNotFoundException.php
  • app/Exceptions/Agency/AgencyTourFetchFailedException.php
  • app/Exceptions/Agency/ModerationNotFoundException.php
  • app/Exceptions/Agency/ModerationNotSharableException.php
  • app/Exceptions/Agency/AgencyExceptionHttpMapper.php (toStatusCode(): 400 / 403 / 404 / 500)
  • app/Repositories/Agency/AgencyRepository.php — absorbs AgencyClass::getAgencyDetailsBySubAgentID(), AgencyClass::createQueryAgencyTours(), and the inline tableAgency() / tableModeration() queries currently living inside GetModerationData

Tests:

  • tests/Exceptions/Agency/AgencyExceptionHttpMapperTest.php

Branching

Branch enhance/issue-1372-agency-adr-foundation off main. Tasks 2 and 3 stack on top of this branch because they share these files.

Acceptance criteria

  • No behavior change on GET /agency/tours and GET /agency/moderation-data
  • No SQL outside AgencyRepository
  • Mapper unit test passes

Note from Developer

Resolved by PR #1612 (enhance/issue-1372-agency-adr-foundation, merged into main) — shared ADR foundation for the Agency domain. No route or response behavior changed; this branch only adds infrastructure consumed by #1610 and #1611.

  • New AgencyDomainException base (extends the global App\Exceptions\DomainException, exposes getDomainCode()), plus AgencyNotFoundException, ModerationNotFoundException, ModerationNotSharableException, and AgencyExceptionHttpMapper::toStatusCode().
  • Deviation from scope: AgencyTourFetchFailedException was not created — no failure branch in either endpoint reaches it. InvalidAgencyRequestException (AGENCY.INVALID_INPUT → 400) was added instead, because /agency/moderation-data needs an explicit 400 for a missing mid. The mapper therefore emits 400 / 403 / 404 only; unhandled failures fall through to errorResponseFromThrowable() for the 500 case.
  • New AgencyRepository absorbs AgencyClass::getAgencyDetailsBySubAgentID(), AgencyClass::createQueryAgencyTours(), and the inline tableAgency() / tableModeration() queries previously living inside GetModerationData. Exposed as findAgencyDetailsBySubAgent(), countAgencyTours(), getAgencyTours(), hasModerationAccess(), findModerationShareData(), with the shared buildToursQuery() private. Left non-final for the same reason as ToursRepository / LevelRepository (test doubles).
  • ResponseEnvelopeHelper::rawResponse() added here (not in the original scope) so #1611 can return the plain {statusCode, data} envelope without an encrypt step.
  • Follow-up commit dce7357 hardened the foundation against null agency_id and translation-key drift; agency messages now live under messages.agency.* in resources/lang/en/messages.php.
domainCode HTTP Condition
AGENCY.INVALID_INPUT 400 Required input missing or invalid
AGENCY.NOT_FOUND 404 No agency accessible to the caller
AGENCY.MODERATION_NOT_FOUND 404 No moderation row, or caller lacks agency access to it
AGENCY.MODERATION_NOT_SHARABLE 403 Moderation row exists but sharable === "0"

Affected API endpoint: none — infrastructure only.

issues.display_title: Issue #1610: Enhancement: GET /agency/tours to ADR pattern
issues.main_description_html:
Part 2/3 of the Agency Domain Passthrough enhancement — move GET /agency/tours onto the ADR pattern.

Depends on #1609 (shared exceptions, mapper, repository).

Enhancement architecture

Target: Domain-Based ADR per docs/ARCH_RULES.md.

GetAgencyToursController (HTTP input, encrypted envelope, exception mapping)
   -> GetAgencyToursAction (use case)
      -> AgencyRepository (SQL)
  • Input contract: GetAgencyToursDto, validated by GetAgencyToursValidator
  • Failures: throw AgencyNotFoundException; the controller maps it to a status via AgencyExceptionHttpMapper
  • Encryption stays at the controller edge; the Action returns a plain array
  • Reference implementation: app/Http/Controllers/Photographers/Portfolio/GetPortfolioController.php

Scope

Create:

  • app/DTOs/Agency/GetAgencyToursDto.php (agency_id, limit default 10, page default 1, search, filter)
  • app/Validators/Agency/GetAgencyToursValidator.php
  • app/Actions/Agency/GetAgencyToursAction.php — pagination math plus panorama thumbnail hydration
  • app/Http/Controllers/Agency/Tours/GetAgencyToursController.php — single handle(), keeps the encrypted response

Update:

  • routes/agencyRoutes.php points /tours at the new controller

Delete:

  • app/Http/Controllers/Agency/Actions/GetAgencyTours.php
  • AgencyController@getAgencyTours

Tests:

  • tests/Actions/Agency/GetAgencyToursActionTest.php

Branching

Branch enhance/issue-1372-agency-tours off enhance/issue-1372-agency-adr-foundation (stacked).

Acceptance criteria

  • Response payload is byte-identical to the current encrypted result: last_login, encrypt, agency_details, pagination, tours — the dashboard consumes this shape
  • Status codes unchanged: 400 invalid input, 404 agency not found, 200 success
  • No SQL outside AgencyRepository, no HTTP concerns inside the Action

Note from Developer

Resolved by PR #1613 (enhance/issue-1372-agency-tours, stacked on enhance/issue-1372-agency-adr-foundation, merged into main).

  • New GetAgencyToursController (single handle()) / GetAgencyToursAction / GetAgencyToursDto / GetAgencyToursValidator, replacing legacy Agency\Actions\GetAgencyTours and AgencyController@getAgencyTours.
  • Encryption stays at the controller edge: the Action returns a plain array, ResponseEnvelopeHelper::encryptResult() produces last_login / encrypt and wraps the payload, so the dashboard's response shape (agency_details, pagination, tours) is unchanged.
  • Pagination math and panorama thumbnail hydration moved into the Action; thumbnails come from ToursLegacyService::getPanoramaThumb() per moderation_id. All SQL now sits behind AgencyRepository (findAgencyDetailsBySubAgent(), countAgencyTours(), getAgencyTours()).
  • AgencyNotFoundException is thrown when the sub-agent has no matching agency; the controller maps it through AgencyExceptionHttpMapper. Input failures come from GetAgencyToursValidator. Defaults limit = 10, page = 1 are applied in the DTO.
  • Route GET /agency/tours repointed in routes/agencyRoutes.php; still behind auth.
domainCode HTTP Condition
AGENCY.INVALID_INPUT 400 Validator rejects limit / page / agency_id
AGENCY.NOT_FOUND 404 No agency accessible to the authenticated sub-agent

Affected API endpoint:

Method Path API Docs
GET /agency/tours get-agency-tours.md (PR #1614)

issues.display_title: Issue #1611: Enhancement: GET /agency/moderation-data to ADR pattern
issues.main_description_html:
Part 3/3 of the Agency Domain Passthrough enhancement — move GET /agency/moderation-data onto the ADR pattern and retire the legacy Agency controller.

Depends on #1609 and #1610.

Enhancement architecture

Target: Domain-Based ADR per docs/ARCH_RULES.md.

GetModerationDataController (HTTP input, plain envelope, exception mapping)
   -> GetModerationDataAction (use case)
      -> AgencyRepository (SQL)
  • Input contract: GetModerationDataDto
  • Failures: ModerationNotFoundException (404) and ModerationNotSharableException (403) replace the current inline status branching; AgencyExceptionHttpMapper maps both at the controller edge
  • This endpoint returns a plain (unencrypted) envelope, unlike /agency/tours
  • Reference implementation: app/Http/Controllers/Photographers/Portfolio/GetPortfolioController.php

Scope

Create:

  • app/DTOs/Agency/GetModerationDataDto.php (mid required, agency_id)
  • app/Actions/Agency/GetModerationDataAction.php — agency access check through AgencyRepository, returns the share link
  • app/Http/Controllers/Agency/Moderation/GetModerationDataController.php

Update:

  • routes/agencyRoutes.php points /moderation-data at the new controller
  • Move the hardcoded https://gothru.co/moderator2/ prefix into config or a domain helper
  • docs/ADR_MIGRATION_CANDIDATES.md: mark the Agency row done
  • docs/ADR_MIGRATED_APIS.md: add both Agency endpoints

Delete:

  • app/Http/Controllers/Agency/Actions/GetModerationData.php
  • app/Http/Controllers/Agency/AgencyController.php (empty once both methods are gone)

Tests:

  • tests/Actions/Agency/GetModerationDataActionTest.php

Branching

Branch enhance/issue-1372-agency-moderation-data off enhance/issue-1372-agency-tours (stacked).

Acceptance criteria

  • Response shape unchanged: data is the share link string on 200
  • 403 still returned when sharable === "0", 404 when there is no agency access or no moderation row, 400 when mid is missing
  • Legacy AgencyController and both legacy Action classes removed
  • Docs updated

Note from Developer

Resolved by PR #1614 (enhance/issue-1372-agency-moderation-data, stacked on enhance/issue-1372-agency-tours, merged into main) — the last Agency passthrough endpoint in this batch.

  • New GetModerationDataController / GetModerationDataAction / GetModerationDataDto, replacing legacy Agency\Actions\GetModerationData. AgencyController.php is now deleted — the Agency domain is entirely single-action controllers.
  • Plain envelope, not encrypted: the controller returns ResponseEnvelopeHelper::rawResponse($link, 200), so data is still the share-link string on 200.
  • Inline status branching replaced by domain exceptions: hasModerationAccess() false → ModerationNotFoundException; no moderation row → ModerationNotFoundException; sharable === "0" → ModerationNotSharableException. A missing mid throws InvalidAgencyRequestException at the controller edge. All mapped by AgencyExceptionHttpMapper.
  • The hardcoded https://gothru.co/moderator2/ prefix moved into config/agency.php (AGENCY_MODERATOR_BASE_URL env override) and is built by the new App\Helpers\Agency\ModerationShareLinkHelper::build(). bootstrap/app.php registers the config.
  • Docs updated in this PR: docs/ADR_MIGRATION_CANDIDATES.md Agency row marked done, docs/ADR_MIGRATED_APIS.md rows 173–174 added, and both docs/v2/agency/*.md pages written (covering #1610's endpoint too).
domainCode HTTP Condition
AGENCY.INVALID_INPUT 400 mid missing
AGENCY.MODERATION_NOT_FOUND 404 Caller has no agency access, or no moderation row for mid
AGENCY.MODERATION_NOT_SHARABLE 403 Moderation row exists but sharable === "0"

Affected API endpoint:

Method Path API Docs
GET /agency/moderation-data get-moderation-data.md (PR #1614)

issues.display_title: Issue #1618: Enhancement: GET /preview-audit/usage to ADR pattern
issues.main_description_html:
Part of #1384 - Migrate getPreviewUsage to Domain-Based ADR pattern (DTO + Repository + ExceptionMapper + standard response envelope).

Category B — already delegates to a legacy Action class.

Note from Developer

Resolved by PR #1620 (enhance/issue-1618-get-preview-usage-adr, merged into main).

  • New GetPreviewUsageController / GetPreviewUsageAction / PreviewUsageDto / PreviewUsageValidator, replacing legacy Tours\Preview\Action\PreviewUsage. Legacy action class deleted.
  • Shared Preview domain infrastructure introduced here (used by #1619): PreviewRepository, PreviewLimitHelper, PreviewDomainException hierarchy + PreviewExceptionHttpMapper, lang keys.
  • Bug fixed: usage counts above the cap previously yielded a negative remainingUsage on the read path. Now reads as exhausted (403), matching the write path guard.
  • Response contract additive: error bodies gain a machine-readable data.reason (invalid_input, limit_reached). Success shape unchanged.
domainCode HTTP Condition
PREVIEW.INVALID_INPUT 400 tourKey or tourType missing, or unknown tourType
PREVIEW.LIMIT_REACHED 403 tour already consumed its 3 previews

Affected API endpoint:

Method Path API Docs
GET /preview-audit/usage/{tourKey}/{tourType} get-preview-usage.md

issues.display_title: Issue #1619: Enhancement: POST /preview-audit/usage to ADR pattern
issues.main_description_html:
Part of #1384 - Migrate postPreviewUsage to Domain-Based ADR pattern (DTO + Repository + ExceptionMapper + standard response envelope).

Category B — already delegates to a legacy Action class.

Note from Developer

Resolved by PR #1621 (enhance/issue-1619-post-preview-usage-adr, stacked on enhance/issue-1618-get-preview-usage-adr, merged into main) — the last Preview passthrough endpoint in this batch.

  • New PostPreviewUsageController / PostPreviewUsageAction, replacing legacy Tours\Preview\Action\PostPreviewUsage. Legacy PreviewController and both Action classes now deleted — the Preview domain is entirely migrated.
  • Reuses infrastructure from #1618: PreviewRepository, PreviewUsageDto, PreviewUsageValidator, PreviewLimitHelper, exception hierarchy + mapper, lang keys.
  • Bug fixed (row lock): legacy called DB::beginTransaction() on the default connection while taking lockForUpdate() on the hosted_tours connection where preview_audit lives. The lock released immediately, and the documented race condition was never prevented. PreviewRepository::transaction() now runs on the owning connection, so the read-check-write is genuinely serialized.
  • Validation now runs before a transaction is opened rather than inside one.
  • Response contract additive: error bodies gain a machine-readable data.reason (invalid_input, limit_reached). Success shape unchanged.
domainCode HTTP Condition
PREVIEW.INVALID_INPUT 400 tourKey or tourType missing, or unknown tourType
PREVIEW.LIMIT_REACHED 403 tour already consumed its 3 previews

Method Path API Docs
POST /preview-audit/usage post-preview-usage.md
